by_situation.prompt:
Situation: The learner is in {area}, their own region, and is open to relocating. Say so: "open to relocating". Demand is ahead of supply here, which is a good sign for finding work nearby after qualifying. Say "demand is ahead of supply". End by saying that, if they relocate, they should look first at {alternatives}.
Slots: {qualification} = the qualification's name; {area} = the region's name; {demand} = how many posting records are here, this time "3 of the 8 posting records nationwide (38%)"; {supply} = how many centers are here, this time "3 of its 26 recorded centers (12%)"; {alternatives} = the other region or regions to look at
